about:
CED Springville operates in Springville, Utah, as a branch of Consolidated Electrical Distributors (CED), a national network with over 700 locations across the United States. The branch's founding date is not publicly disclosed; the national CED organization traces its roots to 1957, but the Springville location's establishment year is not specified in available sources. Ownership details for the branch are not stated.

The company functions as an electrical products distributor and solutions provider, stocking a broad range of equipment from manufacturers such as Schneider Electric and its flagship brand Square D. Its service offerings include switchgear quotations, project management, lighting quotations, lighting design packages, and delivery service. The branch emphasizes a large local inventory backed by nationwide supply chain access, competitive pricing, and a dedicated team focused on quick response times.

CED Springville serves residential electrical contractors, commercial electrical contractors, multifamily construction projects, hybrid mixed-use developments, industrial facilities, and solar installations. Customers range from contractors seeking panelboards, circuit breakers, and safety switches to project managers requiring coordinated material delivery and design support.

The branch highlights "service, integrity, and reliability" as core values, positioning itself on local expertise combined with the purchasing power of a national distributor. Its differentiation rests on the ability to provide both immediate product availability from stock and engineered solutions such as custom switchgear and lighting design packages.
